name: ZS Soybean Carry — Year-over-Year Path Comparison
description: Overlays ZS soybean carry (cont.carry = M1/M2 - 1) for each calendar year 2022–2026, aligned by day-of-year on a shared x-axis. Answers: is March 2026 carry normal or an outlier vs recent history? Includes a summary table of March carry stats (mean, min, max, current) by year.
source:
# =============================================================================
# ZS SOYBEAN CARRY — YEAR-OVER-YEAR PATH COMPARISON
# =============================================================================
#
# Overlays each calendar year's carry path on a shared day-of-year x-axis.
# carry = cont.carry = M1/M2 - 1 (positive = backwardation, negative = contango)
#
# NoAdjustment: carry is a ratio of raw prices — adjustment methods would
# distort the M1/M2 relationship. Must use NoAdjustment for term structure.
#
# assets=[] — all data loaded via reference_futures (no market_data_source).
# =============================================================================

# --- Data: ZS front-month continuation ---
zs_ref = reference_futures(ticker='ZS')()
zs_cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment,
    spread_depth=1
)(zs_ref.o, zs_ref.h, zs_ref.l, zs_ref.c, zs_ref.v, zs_ref.oi, zs_ref.s)

carry = zs_cont.carry

# --- Calendar components ---
ts = index()
year_num  = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.year)(ts)
doy       = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.day_of_year)(ts)
month_num = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.month)(ts)

# --- Filter to 2022–2026 only ---
# Keeps the chart readable (5 lines) and focused on recent carry regimes
in_window = year_num >= 2022 and year_num <= 2026
carry_window = where(in_window, carry)
doy_window   = where(in_window, doy)
year_label   = where(in_window, year_num)

# --- March filter for summary table ---
# Isolate March bars across all years to compare March carry levels
is_march = month_num == 3
carry_march = where(is_march, carry)

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 1: Year-over-Year Carry Path (split by year label)
# x = day-of-year (1–365), one line per year, aligned for direct comparison
# =============================================================================
xy_lines(
    title='ZS Soybean Carry by Day-of-Year: Is 2026 an Outlier?',
    category='Carry Path',
    split_by_label=True,
    y_axis_label='Carry (M1/M2 - 1)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=4,
    x_axis_label='Day of Year',
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Flat (Contango/Backwardation boundary)')
    ]),
    order=1
)(x_values=doy_window, y_values=carry_window, label=year_label)

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 2: March Carry Stats by Year (RowSpec GROUP BY)
# groupKey = year_num (2022=1, 2023=2, ... mapped by col_headers position)
# Uses RowSpec mode: 2 inputs (carry_march, year_num)
# col_headers define the 5 year columns; rows define Mean/Max/Min/Current
# =============================================================================
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='March Carry by Year — Is 2026 Normal?',
        col_headers=['2022', '2023', '2024', '2025', '2026'],
        rows=[
            RowSpec(name='Mean (March)', agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            RowSpec(name='Max (March)',  agg=AggregationType.Max,  type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            RowSpec(name='Min (March)',  agg=AggregationType.Min,  type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            RowSpec(name='Last (March)', agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4)
        ]
    ),
    category='Carry Path',
    order=0
)(carry_march, year_num)
